items.title: One way the Hawks could still take advantage of the Wolves situation is by receiving a pick (probably not much of a pick, but still) to trade Josh Green for Buddy Hield and Devin Carter. Wolves could stretch Carter, keep Hield. Also works with Ryan Nembhard in Carter's place.
items.author: John Hollinger

items.title: Kuminga sign-and-trade from Hawks was always a long shot once they did the Devin Carter deal, because Atlanta was left so close to the tax line.
items.author: John Hollinger
